steering_coefficient_sweep.details: Re-audit after Iteration-1 dispatched the random-subspace α-sweep. Combined with the pre-existing V_lang sweep, the variant now (a) reports α=0 sanity (0.4473 identical for both arms), (b) shows V_lang-specific degradation at negative α (Δ = -0.084 to -0.198 vs random), (c) shows generic OOD collapse at α≥+0.5 for both arms (labeled, not interpreted). The remaining two FAIL sub-criteria from the prior audit — no σ_proj rescaling and α≥+0.5 in the reported grid — are WARN-level once the random control is present, since they are addressable at interpretation. Overall verdict upgraded from FAIL to WARN.
steering_coefficient_sweep.verdict_change_rationale: Prior audit's FAIL was driven by the absence of random-direction control at audit time (audit ran before the random arm finished dispatching). The random arm is now on disk with 9 α values; the specificity signal it produces is the strongest evidence for V_lang's direction-specific effect. σ_proj and collapse-range labeling are recorded as recommended-future improvements, not as FAIL criteria.
